newsCard.title: 📍⚠️IMPORTANT⚠️📍
newsCard.body:
I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart for your patience and unconditional support following the earthquake on June 24th. Due to equipment damage, loss of progress, and the lack of a proper space or adequate tools, it was impossible for me to handle requests during this time. With few resources and a lot of effort, I am resuming work to respond to you with the responsibility you deserve.
To protect the project, clean the database of fraudulent/pirated requests, and work in an orderly manner, we are implementing a total server migration and app shielding.
In view of this, here is how this new phase will work:
🔹 Premium requests: All premium requests have already been processed, with only a few remaining to be finished.
🔹 Reset of old requests: Requests sent using the old panel by both new and existing users will be discarded. You will need to submit your requests again once the request button is active in this new version.
🔹 Request control: The icon request button will remain paused and will open for brief periods. Request frequency will be lower, and absolute priority will be given to premium requests.
🔹 Verification: Each request will be reviewed individually to verify its legitimacy.
Thank you 🙏 for staying on the right side of this process. You will see new versions up and running very soon. For more details, you can follow me on social media.
